title: Tower Near Eglinton GO in Scarborough Revised to 49 Storeys
summary: A revised proposal has been submitted to the City of Toronto for 2941 Eglinton Avenue East in Scarborough, where a Site Plan Approval resubmission seeks to advance a 49-storey mixed-use condominium tower planned beside Eglinton GO station. Designed by Kirkor Architects and Planners for Achille Developments, the latest plans increase the building’s storey count from the previously approved 46 storeys to 49 storeys, while slightly reducing its overall height.
